cases.name: S6b-1: no Save, Reload, Preview or Apply row; first run writes nothing on open
S6b-1: adding a rule and leaving the field saves exactly that list, other settings unchanged, and it survives a restart
S6b-1: a blank new row writes nothing; deleting the last rule saves an empty list
S6b-1: exact-path entries keep their id, scope and bytes across glob saves
S6b-2: adding a rule asks in place, without taking focus; nothing is removed without the answer; Keep them keeps files
S6b-2 B4: Remove from search applies the saved rules and says it in plain words, including what was not checked
B4: a partial removal names what was not checked in plain words and offers Try again
B4: a bare success receipt is never shown as a complete removal
S6b-7: with the Worker down a skip rule still saves through the Head and removal says it cannot run now
B2: when the saved list changes while the ask is open, the ask is withdrawn and asked again for the new list
B2: one ask at a time across several added rules
S6b-3: a half pattern is never saved or applied; the reason shows; fixing it saves
S6b-3: a legacy saved literal-name rule does not block saving other edits
S6b-4: typing during an in-flight save keeps the field usable, never shows later text as saved, then saves it too
S6b-4: while text is unsaved after an in-flight save it is not called saved
B3: an unknown outcome says Not sure this saved, keeps the same key and bytes, and reconciles before a newer draft
B3: leaving Library or switching tabs leaves the field and saves
B3: a load failure says so with Try again, and the editor is not editable until loaded
S6b-5: another window changed the rules: draft kept, Changed elsewhere offers both choices, no silent overwrite
S6b-5: Use the saved rules takes the other window's list and writes nothing
S6b-5: an unrelated save elsewhere does not raise a conflict or lose the draft
512-entry capacity refusal keeps the draft and the saved rules, in plain words
S6b-6: the battery rule saves on change, first change keeps a null schedule, carrying the revision it was based on
S6b-6: hours save on change; an invalid combination is not sent and says why; turning hours off keeps days and times
B6: hours changed in another window: draft kept, Changed elsewhere, Keep my draft writes on the shown revision; Use the saved rules writes nothing
B6: an unrelated save elsewhere does not stop a reading-hours change
overlap: skip-rule save, hours save and toolbar pause/resume never leave a stale witness or lose a draft
S6b-9 B5: Undo is offered for the last glob change only, restores the rule list only and keeps hidden settings
B5: the Undo detail says removed files come back when read again
B5: no Undo once another settings save happened since, for an earlier glob change, or for exact-path removal
B4: per-rule Preview counts are behind developer tools only
S6b-12: an override keeps the editor editable and saved, explains when it takes effect, and asks nothing
Tab out of a new rule saves it, the ask is announced in place and focus stays where the person went
a save in flight never disables the field being typed in; the later text is saved when the field is left
reading hours save from the keyboard and keep focus on the control
the removal ask fits and reads at 600 px in light
the removal ask fits and reads at 1280 px in light
the removal ask fits and reads at 600 px in dark
the removal ask fits and reads at 1280 px in dark

acceptedRulesPauseResumeUnrelatedWritesAndReplayPreserveEachOther()
